subject: ACME SOC 2 / Security recap & next steps

Subject: ACME SOC 2 / Security recap & next steps

Thanks again for taking the time today — really appreciated the thoughtful questions. Quick recap from our discovery call and the next steps we agreed on so everyone has the same view.

Key pain points you called out
- Audit and evidence: need consolidated SOC 2 Type II report + pen-test evidence for vendor review.
- Logs & retention: ACME requires immutable audit logs, retention policy of 5–7 years for security/audit teams.
- Data controls: clear DPA terms, encryption at rest using customer KMS, and proof of key management.
- Access & segmentation: need VPC options and role-based access with detailed admin audit trails.

Goals we surfaced
- Security sign-off from ACME legal & infosec by end of May to enable pilot in June.
- Provide evidence pack that satisfies procurement (SOC 2 report + pen test summary + DPA draft).
- Stand up an eval environment with sample data (isolated tenancy) for your security team to validate controls.

What Redwood will deliver (agreed next steps)
1) Share current SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) and our most recent penetration test summary — attached.
2) Send a DPA draft for your legal to review (attached draft + DocuSign prefill link).
3) Provide detailed answers to your audit questions around log retention, KMS, and data deletion policy in a short Q&A doc (by Tue May 4).
4) Schedule a 30-min security deep-dive with Rishi (infra lead) and Neha (security) during the week of May 10 — proposed times below.

Attachments: SOC2-report-2026.pdf, pen-test-summary.pdf, DPA-draft.docx
Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cACMESecDocs (evidence folder), HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/record/ACME-2027-042

Proposed time slots for the security deep-dive (PST):
- Tue May 11, 9:00–9:30am
- Wed May 12, 11:00–11:30am
- Thu May 13, 2:00–2:30pm

Please confirm which slot works and if you want any additional artifacts in the packet. I can loop in our legal ops if your legal team wants to redline the DPA directly.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Subject: Re: ACME SOC 2 / Security recap & next steps

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap and the attachments. This is helpful. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

- Retention: ACME’s baseline is 7 years for security/audit logs; would you be able to provide immutable retention at that duration or an explanation of how we can export and archive logs to meet that requirement?
- KMS: we use a customer-managed KMS. Can you confirm Redwood supports bringing our KMS keys (or a KMS in our account) for encryption-at-rest?
- Evidence: for procurement we typically need signed pen-test summaries and a SOC 2 Type II PDF that includes the scope; do you have a vendor-facing attest or an ISO equivalent?

Also looping in our legal (legal@acme.com) — they’ll take a look at the DPA draft and will likely ask for a couple redlines re: data deletion and subcontractor lists. Can you provide an anticipated timeline for returning a fully executed DPA once redlines are discussed? We’re hoping to get security sign-off by end of May as discussed.

If it helps, Priya and I can do the May 11 slot (9am PST).

Thanks,
James
Director, Vendor Security | ACME Corp

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: James Carter <james.carter@acme.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>, legal@acme.com
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME SOC 2 / Security recap & next steps

Thanks James — great questions. Short answers up front, followed by next steps and owners: 

- Retention & audit logs: Redwood supports configurable retention windows and exportable immutable logs. For long-term archival (7 years), we typically export to customer-owned S3 buckets with immutability settings; we’ll include a short how-to and retention SLA in the Q&A doc (owner: Neha, delivery Tue May 4).
- KMS & encryption: We support customer-managed KMS keys (bring-your-own-key via AWS KMS, GCP KMS). I’ll capture the exact config steps and our key rotation policy in the evidence packet (owner: Rishi).
- Evidence: SOC 2 Type II (PDF) and pen-test summary are attached; the pen-test doc includes scope and vendor signature. If your procurement needs a specific signed attestation, let us know the exact wording and we’ll work with our security ops to get it.

Timeline for DPA: once your legal returns redlines we typically turn around a counter-signature within 5–7 business days (depends on redline complexity). If ACME needs an accelerated SLA we can fast-track it through our legal ops — we’ll treat this as priority.

Action items (owners):
- Neha (security): produce Q&A on audit logs & retention + upload sample log retention config (due Tue May 4).
- Rishi (infra): produce KMS config notes + evidence of encryption at rest and key handling (due Tue May 4).
- Marissa (AE): send DPA DocuSign prefill + confirm deep-dive slot (I’ll send a calendar invite for Tue May 11, 9:00am PST).

Attached again: SOC2-report-2026.pdf, pen-test-summary.pdf, DPA-draft.docx
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/prepare/xyz-dpa-prefill

Best,
Marissa
